title: Your MCP Server is Bad (and you should feel bad) - Jeremiah Lowin, Prefect
content: **Analysis of the MCP Talk: Agentic Product Design for AI Agents**  Okay, here's the deal. I've taken a deep dive into this YouTube video, focusing on how we build interfaces for AI agents, specifically within the context of MCP (Model-Centric Programming). My aim is to synthesize everything into a concise, technically sound JSON output.  I'm seeing a core argument: traditional APIs, built with humans in mind, don't cut it for AI agents.
